description: This file is a Perl module implementing migration and conversion routines for different SVN layout versions within a git-svn integration context. It contains functions to migrate repositories between different layouts, read old URLs, and optimize SVN remote connections.

methods.name: migrate_from_v0
methods.description: Migrates repositories from a v0 layout to a more recent layout by renaming refs and updating URLs.

methods.name: migrate_from_v1
methods.description: Migrates from a v1 git-svn layout by copying URL info and reorganizing repository directories.

methods.name: read_old_urls
methods.description: Recursively reads stored URLs from old SVN info directories to build a mapping of references to URLs.

methods.name: migrate_from_v2
methods.description: Migrates repositories by reading configuration and URL info, initializing SVN remotes accordingly.

methods.name: minimize_connections
methods.description: Optimizes SVN remote connections by consolidating URLs and updating configurations.

methods.name: migration_check
methods.description: Runs all migration routines and minimizes connections if configured.
